text: {"reconstruction":4,"feasibility":3,"rationale":"The proposal follows the same site order and overall procedure (Wikipedia, timeanddate, Booking, Viator, OpenTable, Notes, Mail), but it is vague or wrong in places: there is no Weather page step, no \"first hotel with score ≥8\" rule (it uses a hard-coded {hotel}/{restaurant} instead), activities are one merged parameter, the Viator \"go back\" step is only implied, there are no do-not-click guards, and it ends with \"Send or discard\" instead of always discarding; it also drops the companion/guests parameter naming and the email body template."}

data.rationale: The proposal follows the same site order and overall procedure (Wikipedia, timeanddate, Booking, Viator, OpenTable, Notes, Mail), but it is vague or wrong in places: there is no Weather page step, no "first hotel with score ≥8" rule (it uses a hard-coded {hotel}/{restaurant} instead), activities are one merged parameter, the Viator "go back" step is only implied, there are no do-not-click guards, and it ends with "Send or discard" instead of always discarding; it also drops the companion/guests parameter naming and the email body template.
